digest.component_or_area: LLM provider integration (OpenAI Responses API readiness)
propositions: Rebar's OpenAI-compatible surface (hosted openai/openai-chat, custom base_url builder, per-candidate endpoint override, gateway/openai, and vendor qualifiers deepseek/grok/xai/groq/cerebras/moonshotai/heroku) must be classified as Responses-ready, Chat-Completions-only, or UNKNOWN with cited evidence from pydantic-ai behavior and source code

Contract tests must verify structured output, streaming, tool calls, 429 retry behavior, and custom-base-URL routing work identically under both openai-chat: and openai-responses: prefixes using real pydantic-ai model construction against a stubbed HTTP transport

Four rebar code sites currently block openai-responses: from being usable in production: KNOWN_PROVIDER_NAMES lacking the prefix, _pydantic_ai_known_providers deriving from known_model_names() with no openai-responses entries, _PROFILE_RESOLVERS missing openai-responses key, and openai: normalizers hard-coding Chat pin

Only hosted OpenAI via infer_model is Responses-ready under pydantic-ai 1.107.2 pin; custom base_url, gateway/openai, and all vendor qualifiers (rows 2-8) construct only Chat Completions or are untestable without optional package extras
xai: and groq: endpoints remain UNKNOWN because optional dependencies (xai-sdk, groq packages) are not installed and rebar extras do not include them
After the named rebar-side unblocks (155c edit-set) are applied, openai-responses: prefix will be resolvable and routable through pydantic-ai's Responses model construction path
